scope: Original FAST overlay source and conditional graph recurrence budget. All candidate frames admitted, no geometry-keyframe deletions; does not claim actual observed graph or trajectory. Same encoder, learned weights and original Update arithmetic.

lifecycle_semantics.later_admitted: 1 Update before geometry-dependent keyframe deletion and source-age pruning
lifecycle_semantics.edge_order: old patches→new target then new patches→window targets including self

MAC_convention.MAC: one multiplication plus accumulation; 2 FP arithmetic ops for a conventional FLOP count

20Hz_planning.claim: FAST materially reduces graph work but does not establish 20Hz. The existing rejected encoder diagnostic alone averages207ms (spatial) /420ms (original). New sampling/placement/IO timings and complete fresh-frame Update+corr+BA/quality remain unmeasured; this is not a proof of hardware impossibility.
